Attachment.description: An image or video shown with a question or a choice.
Attachment.title: Attachment

CalculationFormat.description:
How a calculated field shows its value (display only; the stored
value is the computed one).

style.description: number (default), currency, percent (0.25 shows as 25%) or text.
style.title: Style

CalculationFormat.title: CalculationFormat

Choice.description:
One option of a choice question. Logic conditions compare with
``value``.

logic.description: Offer this option only (SHOW) or unless (HIDE) its conditions hold, at most 20. The conditions read earlier questions of the form. An answer that selects an option that is not offered is refused.

Choice.title: Choice

Condition.description:
One condition of a visibility rule or a page jump: the answer of
``fieldId`` compared with ``value`` (a choice's value, "Yes"/"No" for a
yes/no question). On a repeating group, ``groupMode`` COUNT compares
the number of items; ANY / ALL test ``childFieldId`` in the items.

fieldType.description: Type of the source question (filled in by the editor).
fieldType.title: Fieldtype

Condition.title: Condition

Container.description:
A layout container on a page: ``panel`` (a titled group that opens and
closes; ``collapsed``: closed when the page opens), ``fieldset`` (a
bordered group with a legend) or ``tabs`` (a strip of ``tabs``, no title
of its own). A panel and a field set list their questions in ``fields``;
the questions of one container are next to each other on the page, in the
order given, and are questions of the page itself (never a repeating
group's children). ``logic`` shows or hides the whole container. Layout
only: answers, logic, rules and exports see the questions as before.
Container.title: Container

ContainerTab.description:
One tab of a ``tabs`` container: its title and its questions (ids, in
page order). A tab may be empty.
ContainerTab.title: ContainerTab

DateRule.description:
The chosen date must be ``comparison`` a fixed ``date`` (YYYY-MM-DD),
today, or the answer of another date question (``fieldId``).
DateRule.title: DateRule

Ending.description:
A page shown after submitting. A page jump may choose one by its
``id``; a plain submit shows the default ending (the one with
``isDefault``, else the first).

id.description: Stable id that page jumps name. Given when left out.
id.title: Id

name.description: Short internal name, e.g. Eligible. Respondents never see it.
name.title: Name

isDefault.description: Shown after a plain submit. At most one ending.
isDefault.title: Isdefault

Ending.title: Ending

FormField.description: A question or content block on a page (or inside a group).

anyOf.description: Legacy types the builder no longer offers: still accepted so that stored forms can be read; do not use them for new questions.

type.description: A question or content block type.
type.title: FieldType

title.description: Plain text, or a rich-text document (which may pipe answers and hidden fields).
title.title: Title

internal.description: For office use only: never shown to respondents, filled in by staff on each submission.
internal.title: Internal

colSpan.description: Width on a 12-column grid (12 = full row).
colSpan.title: Colspan

label.description: Short label shown with a date picker.
label.title: Label

dateRules.description: Constraints on a date or day question's answer.
dateRules.title: Daterules

minTime.description: A time question: the earliest time that can be answered (HH:MM, 24-hour).
minTime.title: Mintime

maxTime.description: A time question: the latest time that can be answered (HH:MM, 24-hour).
maxTime.title: Maxtime

currencies.description: A currency question: the ISO 4217 codes respondents may pick (the first is the default). Amounts are answered with min/max in validations.
currencies.title: Currencies

countries.description: An address question: the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries respondents may give (default: NL only).
countries.title: Countries

addressLookup.description: An address question: fill in street and city from a Dutch postcode and house number while the server offers it (default: yes).
addressLookup.title: Addresslookup

optionFilter.description: A choice question's options filtered by an earlier choice question's answer (see OptionFilter).

optionSource.description: A dropdown or multiple choice question's options taken from a workspace list or from another form's answers instead of choices (see OptionSource).

shareAsChoices.description: A short text, dropdown or multiple choice question: its answers may be shown as choices in other forms of the same workspace (an optionSource of kind form_answers). Off unless true. Respondents are told next to the question; only answers given while a version with it on was filled are ever offered.
shareAsChoices.title: Shareaschoices

library.description: Set when the question was copied from a reusable section of the workspace's library (see LibraryOrigin).

rules.description: At most 8 rules per question and 100 per form (see Rule).
rules.title: Rules

expression.description: A calculated field's formula as an expressions-v1 syntax tree (docs/spec/expressions-v1.md), e.g. {"+": [{"var": "<field id>"}, 1]}. Variables are question ids, '<group id>.<question id>' for a repeating group's question, and hidden-field names.
expression.title: Expression

hiddenFromRespondents.description: A calculated field that is computed and stored but never shown to respondents.
hiddenFromRespondents.title: Hiddenfromrespondents

unansweredAsZero.description: A calculated field: unanswered questions it uses count as 0 (default: on, unless the format is text).
unansweredAsZero.title: Unansweredaszero

FormField.title: FormField

Layout.description: How a page, the welcome page or an ending is laid out.
Layout.title: Layout

LibraryOrigin.description:
Where a question was copied from: the workspace library's reusable
section (``sectionId``), the version copied, the question's id in that
section (``key``) and the insert it belongs to (``instance``). Set by the
server when a section is inserted; read-only in spirit (a copy to another
workspace drops it).
LibraryOrigin.title: LibraryOrigin

Logic.description:
Show or hide this question when its conditions match (operator:
AND = all, OR = any; AND when absent).
Logic.title: Logic

Logo.description: The organisation logo at the top of every respondent page.

url.description: Set by uploading a logo; ignored when a document is written.
url.title: Url

Logo.title: Logo

OptionFilter.description:
Filter a choice question's options by an earlier choice question's
answer: the options offered are those the chosen options of ``fieldId``
map to (the union over a multiple choice's selection). Without an answer
to it (or with only "Other" text) nothing is filtered; a chosen option
with no entry offers nothing.
OptionFilter.title: OptionFilter

OptionFilterEntry.description:
While the earlier question's option ``when`` (its id) is chosen, the
question offers the options in ``show`` (their ids).
OptionFilterEntry.title: OptionFilterEntry

OptionSource.description:
Where a dropdown or multiple choice question's options come from
instead of ``choices``: ``kind`` ``list`` (a workspace's option list,
``listId``; ``parentFieldId`` names an earlier choice question whose
answer narrows the list by each item's group) or ``form_answers`` (the
answers to question ``questionId`` of another form ``formId`` of the same
workspace; the saver needs permission to read that form's responses).
A question has either a source or ``choices``, never both. Checked by
the server on every save and again on every submission.
OptionSource.title: OptionSource

Page.description: A page of questions, in the order respondents see them.

containers.description: Panels, field sets and tabs that group questions of this page.
containers.title: Containers

Page.title: Page

PageJump.description:
After this page, go to ``target`` (a page id, or "__SUBMIT__" to
end the form) when the conditions match. The first matching jump wins;
no match goes to the next page. With "__SUBMIT__", ``endingId`` names
the ending shown after submitting (default: the form's default
ending).

endingId.description: The id of an ending of this form; only with target "__SUBMIT__".
endingId.title: Endingid

PageJump.title: PageJump

Position.description: Where a page sits on the flow view's canvas (cosmetic).
Position.title: Position

Repeat.description: Makes a group repeatable: its questions are answered once per item.
Repeat.title: Repeat

Retention.description:
How long answers are kept: a number of days, until a date
(YYYY-MM-DD), or forever.
Retention.title: Retention

Rule.description:
A field rule: while ``when`` holds, ``then`` applies. A field's rules
apply in order; for each property the last active rule wins
(``required`` starts from ``validations.required``). Rules never show or
hide a question (that is ``logic``).
Rule.title: Rule

RuleSetValue.description:
The value a rule gives the question: a fixed ``const`` (a text, a
number, true/false for yes/no, a YYYY-MM-DD date, or the ``id`` of one of
a choice question's options) or an ``expression``, never both.

const.description: A choice question is set by the id of one of its options.
const.title: Const

RuleSetValue.title: RuleSetValue

RuleThen.description:
What a rule does while it is active (at least one key). The server
enforces ``required``, ``readOnly`` and ``setValue``; ``title`` and
``description`` only change what respondents read.

required.description: true: the question must be answered; false: it is optional.
required.title: Required

readOnly.description: Respondents cannot change the value: a submitted value is discarded (replaced by an active setValue, else removed).
readOnly.title: Readonly

setValue.description: The server computes the value and stores it, whatever a client sent; an empty result leaves the question unanswered. Implies readOnly.

RuleThen.title: RuleThen

RuleWhen.description:
When a rule is active: ``conditions`` (as in ``logic``; operator AND
when absent) or an expressions-v1 ``expression`` (active when its value
is truthy), never both.

expression.description: An expressions-v1 syntax tree (docs/spec/expressions-v1.md) over the form's variables; inside a repeating group a sibling question's id reads that item's answer.
expression.title: Expression

RuleWhen.title: RuleWhen

Theme.description: Colours and style of the form (or of one page, as an override).

titleFont.description: Face of titles and question labels. Absent: the text face (or the style's own title face).
titleFont.title: Titlefont

bodyFont.description: Face of everything else respondents read. Absent: public-sans.
bodyFont.title: Bodyfont

dataFont.description: Face of data such as the submission number. Absent: the app's mono face.
dataFont.title: Datafont

titleWidth.description: Width of display titles: expanded is 125% on a face with a width axis (archivo).
titleWidth.title: Titlewidth

radius.description: Corners of fields, option cards and buttons: sharp 0, soft 6px, round 16px. Absent: the style's own.
radius.title: Radius

highlight.description: The chosen answer, the 'why we ask' and 'optional' notes and, where it reads, the focus ring. Absent: secondary.
highlight.title: Highlight

selection.description: The chosen answer alone, when it should differ from the highlight. Absent: the highlight, else secondary.
selection.title: Selection

inputText.description: The colour of the answers typed in the white input boxes (4.5:1 on white). Absent: primary.
inputText.title: Inputtext

Theme.title: Theme

ThemeBackground.description: Optional decoration of the page ground.

imageUrl.description: Only images from our own storage or Unsplash are shown.
imageUrl.title: Imageurl

artwork.description: Built-in artwork served by the app (marble: a marbled endpaper). It fills the picture half of a welcome or ending page whose layout has one and no image of its own. Absent: none.
artwork.title: Artwork

ThemeBackground.title: ThemeBackground

Trust.description:
What respondents are told about their data, and how answers are
handled.

retentionText.description: An internal note stored with the form. It is not shown to respondents: they see only the retention period the form enforces (see "retention").
retentionText.title: Retentiontext

allowSaveDraft.description: Let respondents save a draft and continue later (off by default). Drafts are encrypted, kept apart from the responses and deleted after draftRetentionDays.
allowSaveDraft.title: Allowsavedraft

draftRetentionDays.description: How many days after the last save a draft is kept, 1 to 90; left out, 30.
draftRetentionDays.title: Draftretentiondays

showReviewPage.description: Respondents see their answers on a page of their own, with a link back to each page, before they send them.
showReviewPage.title: Showreviewpage

Trust.title: Trust

Validations.description:
Answer constraints. Lengths apply to text answers, values to numbers,
choices to multiple-selection questions.

pattern.description: A regular expression the text answer must match.
pattern.title: Pattern

Validations.title: Validations

description: A form, as its creator controls it.

language.description: The language the form's own text (title, questions, choices) is written in, as a short BCP 47 tag. Respondent pages mark that text with it for screen readers and browsers. When a document that replaces a form leaves it out, the form keeps its language; null clears it.
language.title: Language

pages.description: At most 200 pages, with at most 2000 fields in all (group questions included).
pages.title: Pages

hiddenFields.description: URL parameter names captured with each response (names only, never values).
hiddenFields.title: Hiddenfields

title: BetterCollected form spec v1
